description: Department of Local Government - (Western Province) Announce that a meeting in view of selecting a new Chairman for the Vacated Chairman's position of Katana Pradeshiya Sabha of Western Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces a meeting to select a new Chairman for the Katana Pradeshiya Sabha, which is an electoral process matter under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It falls under Type 7 (Elections) as it deals with filling a vacated elected position in local government through a selection meeting, which is part of electoral procedures for local authorities.
